text: Tablet rites reach past the camp and change the world itself. Carve a tablet, seat the matching seal in a Ritual Brazier inside its circle, and spend the Pulse.
pages.title: Weather rites
Carving and casting
text: Each tablet is two stone, a creature reagent and the matching seal, shapeless. The seal is handed back.

Seat that seal in the brazier (its blessing keeps running), draw the [Rite Circle](rite_circle), and gather the full cost within **8 blocks** of the brazier: a well-stocked Drumheart, a Resonator with a good catalyst, or several generators together. A cell in your pocket does not count. A Pulse Gauge or the Codex shows the total.
Crouch and use the tablet on the brazier. If the Lattice holds less than the cost, nothing is spent; otherwise the tablet is consumed and the Pulse drawn.

pages.title: The three weather rites
text: - **Rain Calling** (Water, **400** Pulse, a Reed Fang): twenty minutes of rain, and stronger Ley Collectors while it lasts. Start here.
- **Sky Clearing** (Air, **400**, a Storm Wing): forty minutes of clear sky.
- **Dawn Calling** (Fire, **800**, an Ember Heart): hurries the night to sunrise, unless the game rule tribalpower:allowDawnRite is off.
Four matching totems on the circle's cardinals take a quarter off the cost and double the time. A held redstone signal on the brazier refuses the rite.
